opex.heading: Operating Expenses
opex.text: Total operating expenses for the three months ended July 31, 2026 were $12,182, compared to $6,711 for the three months ended July 31, 2025. The increase was primarily attributable to marketing, professional fees, and general corporate activities to support business growth.

costs.heading: Operating Expenses
costs.text: Total operating expenses for the three months ended July 31, 2026 were $12,182, compared to $6,711 for the three months ended July 31, 2025. The increase was primarily attributable to marketing, professional fees, and general corporate activities to support business growth.

net.heading: Net Loss
net.text: Net Loss for three months ended July 31, 2026 and 2025 was $4,221 and $12,077, respectively.

ocf.text: Operating Activities. Net cash used in operating activities for the three months ended July 31, 2026 was $282, compared to $14,361 for the three months ended July 31, 2025. The decrease in cash outflows was primarily driven by lower net losses of $4,221 (compared to $12,077 in 2025) and an increase in deferred revenue of $11,550 due to advance customer payments, partially offset by an increase in prepaid expenses of $11,350.

net sales.heading: Revenue
net sales.text: For the three months ended July 31, 2026, the Company generated revenue of $17,700, compared to $0 for the three months ended July 31, 2025. The increase was primarily driven by customer subscriptions during the current period.
